# TME Barriers — Raw Sources

Detailed per-paper breakdowns (design, cohort, methods, quantitative results, limitations, conclusions) grounding the TME-barrier concepts. Each file is a leaf node (no `defines`) tagged with its true provenance weight — meta-analyses, randomized trials, and mechanistic primaries at high trust; conference abstracts and press-release figures explicitly flagged.

### Files

- [allen-2017-hev-ltbr.md](allen-2017-hev-ltbr.md) — Allen et al. 2017 — combining anti-VEGFR2 with anti-PD-L1 induces high endothelial venules via LTβR signaling, enriching intratumoral lymphocytes 3–10 fold and shrinking recalcitrant glioblastoma
- [atilla-2022-antigen-loss.md](atilla-2022-antigen-loss.md) — Atilla & Atilla 2022 — antigen-negative relapse rates after CD19 and BCMA CAR-T (CD19-negative 9–25% B-ALL, ~33% DLBCL), a leading cause of relapse despite CAR-T persistence
- [buckanovich-2008-etbr.md](buckanovich-2008-etbr.md) — Buckanovich et al. 2008 — endothelin-B receptor on tumor endothelium suppresses ICAM-1 via nitric oxide to block T-cell homing; ETBR neutralization restores it and enables immunotherapy
- [chang-2015-glucose-competition.md](chang-2015-glucose-competition.md) — Chang et al. 2015 — tumor glucose consumption metabolically restricts T cells, dampening mTOR, glycolytic capacity, and interferon-γ production
- [chen-2023-exhaustion.md](chen-2023-exhaustion.md) — Chen et al. 2023 — T-cell exhaustion is TOX-imprinted and epigenetically locked; durable therapy response depends on the TCF-1+ progenitor pool that solid-tumor TMEs deplete
- [dangaj-2019-ccl5-cxcl9.md](dangaj-2019-ccl5-cxcl9.md) — Dangaj et al. 2019 — a constitutive CCL5 + inducible CXCL9 chemokine relay is required to seed and amplify CD8 T-cell infiltration; its epigenetic loss produces cold tumors
- [han-2025-b2m.md](han-2025-b2m.md) — Han et al. 2025 — β2-microglobulin loss as an immunotherapy-resistance mechanism (B2M altered in 29% of melanoma, HLA-LOH in 40% of NSCLC), and the MSI-H colorectal paradox
- [less-1992-ifp.md](less-1992-ifp.md) — Less/Boucher/Jain 1992 — the seminal human measurement of tumor interstitial fluid pressure (4–50 mmHg, mean 20) versus near-zero in normal tissue
- [long-2019-epacadostat.md](long-2019-epacadostat.md) — Long et al. 2019 (ECHO-301/KEYNOTE-252) — the IDO1 inhibitor epacadostat added nothing to pembrolizumab in phase 3 melanoma (PFS HR 1.00), the definitive IDO failure
- [masugi-2022-desmoplasia.md](masugi-2022-desmoplasia.md) — Masugi 2022 — the desmoplastic stroma of pancreatic cancer occupies >80% of tumor volume, physically excludes T cells (center CD8 <half of margin), and single-target depletion is insufficient
- [molon-2011-ccl2-nitration.md](molon-2011-ccl2-nitration.md) — Molon et al. 2011 — intratumoral peroxynitrite nitrates CCL2 so it can no longer attract CD8 T cells (trapping them in stroma) while myeloid cells still respond
- [motz-2014-endothelial-fasl.md](motz-2014-endothelial-fasl.md) — Motz et al. 2014 — tumor endothelium expresses FasL that selectively kills effector CD8 T cells while sparing Tregs, and disrupting it increases the CD8/Treg ratio and shrinks tumors
- [nakamura-2016-epr.md](nakamura-2016-epr.md) — Nakamura/Kobayashi 2016 — the EPR effect delivers less than 2-fold nanoparticle tumor accumulation and is insufficient for cure, undermined by high IFP and poor perfusion
- [ohta-2020-hypoxia-immune.md](ohta-2020-hypoxia-immune.md) — Ohta 2020 — hypoxia is a common upstream cause of immune exclusion, driving CD39/CD73-adenosine suppression, PD-L1 upregulation, and direct T/NK impairment
- [shang-2015-treg-meta.md](shang-2015-treg-meta.md) — Shang et al. 2015 — meta-analysis of 15,512 patients showing high FoxP3+ regulatory T-cell density predicts worse survival in most solid tumors, but is protective in colorectal and head-and-neck cancer
- [vancutsem-2020-pegph20.md](vancutsem-2020-pegph20.md) — Van Cutsem et al. 2020 (HALO-301) — the hyaluronidase PEGPH20 gave no survival benefit in phase 3 hyaluronan-high pancreatic cancer despite improving ORR, the defining stroma-modifier failure
- [verma-2022-metabolic-obstacles.md](verma-2022-metabolic-obstacles.md) — Verma et al. 2022 — the integrated metabolic obstacles for T cells in the TME: lactate to 50 mM, pH to 6.4, adenosine, potassium checkpoint, and tryptophan/arginine depletion
- [wang-2024-adenosine-coast.md](wang-2024-adenosine-coast.md) — Wang et al. 2024 — adenosine-pathway blockade is inactive as monotherapy but adding anti-CD73 (oleclumab) to durvalumab in stage-III NSCLC (COAST) raised ORR to 30% vs 17.9%
- [xu-2024-ezh2-cxcl9.md](xu-2024-ezh2-cxcl9.md) — Xu et al. 2024 — tumor-intrinsic EZH2 creates the CD8-desert phenotype by depositing H3K27me3 on the CXCL9 promoter; EZH2 inhibition restores CXCL9 and CD8 migration
